title: 'mujhe kuch acha sa suggest karo' returns priced suggestions
messages: mujhe kuch acha sa suggest karo

expected.notes: A general recommendation request must return real, priced items and must never itself add anything to the cart.

title: 'kuch spicy suggest karo' returns priced spicy suggestions, cart untouched

expected.notes: Recommendation must never auto-add — locks rules.ts's RECOMMENDATION_RULE.

title: 'hot and spicy ma kuch batao mujhe' returns real spicy items, never a contentless deflection
messages: hot and spicy ma kuch batao mujhe

expected.notes: Locks the raw-text theme fallback fix — a live bug once returned 'Backend aapko menu se spicy items dikha dega' instead of real content.

title: 'sabse popular item kya hai' returns a real, priced signature item
'kids ke liye kuch batao' returns real, mild, kid-appropriate items
'vegetarian options batao' returns real vegetarian items
A recommendation reply never adds anything to the cart even if the model drafts a cartAction

expected.notes: Structural guarantee: stripAutoAddsWhenRecommending in multi-intent.ts drops any cartAction attached to a recommendation turn.

title: 'burger ke ilawa kya spicy hai' excludes every burger from the suggestion
messages: burger ke ilawa kya spicy hai

expected.notes: Locks the category-exclusion regression fix: once a spicy burger is suggested, explicitly excluding burgers must never re-suggest one.

title: 'burgers ke ilawa kia hai spicy ma' (exact reported bug phrase) excludes burgers
messages: burgers ke ilawa kia hai spicy ma

expected.notes: Verbatim reproduction of the originally-reported bug conversation.

title: 'ye to burger hai na iske ilawa kuch nahi hai spicy ma' (bare reference, no named category) still excludes burgers
messages: ye to burger hai na iske ilawa kuch nahi hai spicy ma

expected.notes: A bare 'iske ilawa' with no explicit category word must fall back to whatever category was last suggested.

title: Every recommended item is shown with its exact PKR price, never just a name

expected.notes: A recommendation naming real items but omitting any price must be replaced with a fully-priced list.

title: A recommendation followed by an explicit 'add kar do' DOES add the item (separate turn, separate intent)
messages: haan Spicy Stuff Burger add kar do

expected.notes: The 'never auto-add' rule only applies to the recommendation turn itself — a later, separate explicit add message is a normal cart mutation.
